parsed.faithful: ENGENDERING, a term fometime ufed for the act of producing or forming any thing: thus meteors are faid to be engendered in the middle region of the atmosphere, and worms in the belly.
parsed.modern: ENGENDERING, a term sometime used for the act of producing or forming any thing: thus meteors are said to be engendered in the middle region of the atmosphere, and worms in the belly.
